title: fix: show chat progress while Codex retries
body:
Closes #202578

## What Problem This Solves

A chat can spend minutes showing typing while Codex retries a model request, leaving people in the group unsure why the answer is taking so long.

## User Impact

Chats that show model-wait progress display “Still working. Retrying…” once while Codex retries. The notice clears when the reply arrives.

## Why This Change Was Made

The app-server’s `willRetry` notification feeds the same progress path as a wait for a model slot. The channel’s preview settings control whether that progress appears.

## Evidence

### Telegram during the second capacity retry

Both screenshots show the second retry in the same private Telegram chat, with a loopback fixture supplying capacity errors.

**Before on main (`1129d4c`)**

![Telegram on main showing only the typing indicator](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/86c7f538-1c17-44b2-9946-9d7cbcb35692)

**After on the PR head (`08de645`)**

![Telegram on the PR head showing “Still working. Retrying…”](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3e2c54b4-2ca5-4c81-ba03-5640cbbfbaa4)

### Reply and removal on the PR head

![Telegram showing the final reply after the retry notice was removed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8386e8da-8378-46ef-9691-cc57b0f4759f)

An isolated Gateway with bundled Codex and automatic text replies enabled received five overload responses from the fixture, then a successful text response. The trace records the live Telegram Bot API receipts. Message IDs are replaced with labels.

```text
+00.000s  Telegram accepted the private test prompt
+06.413s  Codex request 1: capacity error (Retry-After 2s)
+08.542s  Codex request 2: capacity error (Retry-After 12s)
+08.846s  Telegram sendMessage accepted [notice] "Still working. Retrying…"
+20.638s  Codex request 3: capacity error (Retry-After 2s)
+22.735s  Codex request 4: capacity error (Retry-After 2s)
+24.831s  Codex request 5: capacity error (Retry-After 2s)
+26.923s  Codex request 6: successful final text response
+28.170s  Telegram sendMessage accepted [reply] "I can reply now."
+29.108s  Telegram deleteMessage accepted [notice]
```

Ran the issue’s loopback Telegram supergroup reproduction with the real Gateway and bundled Codex. Both builds made six generation requests with five overload retries and shortened delays.

| Scenario | Observed Telegram delivery |
| --- | --- |
| Main (`2aca1a1`) | Typing during retries, then one final answer. The retry-notice assertion failed. |
| This change | One notice during the wait, then the final answer and deletion of that notice. |
| Previews off | One final answer. |
| Healthy first response | One final answer. |

After pr-simplify, 101 tests passed across the reply runner, queued follow-ups, Codex terminal events, and Telegram progress lifecycle. Core and extension type checks, targeted lint and formatting, and the Gateway build passed. Local Codex autoreview of the full diff found no actionable P0–P2 issues. The supergroup reproduction used loopback Telegram and Responses fixtures.
